name: Undo the Mustache Curse, Witch!
source:
You play as the young knight Cierre, who is tasked by Princess Elderflower to help her undo the mustache curse placed on her by the infamous Witch of the Lake. It's paramount that this quest be completed tonight- Elderflower can't let her betrothed see her like this, after all...

Will their confrontation with the witch end up a close shave, or a hack job?

[From [url=https://zelan.itch.io/undo-the-mustache-curse-witch]itch.io[/url]]
